LOCAL ARCHIVE

Saved runs

Open a run to explore its results without a running engine. Everything shown was computed when the run was exported.

From your computer

Choose the run folder that contains manifest.json. Files stay on your computer.

From a stored bundle

Export a run from the local engine

Export your settings and decisions with the live Studio's Export run button, then run:

utilsim export-run --input your-run.json --store out/store

For a prebuilt town:

utilsim export-run --town small_town --as-of 2026-12-31 --store out/store

Open the resulting out/store/runs/<runKey> folder here. Tables capture the export date. Workspace snapshots capture each month end, plus the export date. Changing a run requires a live engine and a new export.

A utility batch (utilsim batch-run) opens as one utility on the utility page: serve the store with UTILSIM_RUN_STORE=out/store node web/serve.mjs and open utility.html?batch=/batches/<jobKey>/. Each of its districts opens here.
